values.note: 64 sites on paved roads (FS); rec.gov catalogs 63, two of them tent-only, with lengths 30-84 ft and 10 pull-throughs. rec.gov: 'RV or trailers over 36 feet will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees.' Rigs must fit the parking spur, off the grass.

sites.source: FS page ('There are paved roads within the campground connecting the 64 sites') + rec.gov notice ('RV or trailers over 36 feet will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees'; 'All vehicles including campers must fit in parking spur (not on grass)') + rec.gov catalog (63 sites: 61 RV/trailer-capable, 2 tent-only; Max Vehicle Length 30-84; Driveway Entry 39 Back-In / 10 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: FS page ('This is a standard, nonelectric campground') + rec.gov catalog (all 63 sites STANDARD/RV/TENT NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Vault toilets; drinking water during the full-service season only, and Colorado rules bar attaching hoses to hydrants to fill RV tanks. Pre-season and extended season have reduced service (water, trash or a host may not be available). Firewood sold by the host.

facilities.source: FS page ('Restroom, Vault toilets'; 'Potable water is available at this site. Water is available during the full-service season'; 'Pre-season and extended season have reduced service; amenities such as water, trash or a host may not be available') + rec.gov notices ('Colorado State regulations prohibit attaching hoses to hydrants to fill RV's'; 'Firewood is available for sale at host site'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: FS: open early May to late October, full service Memorial Day week to mid-September. Dates are 2026's, when rec.gov sells first-come sites either side of the reservation season.

season.source: FS page ('The campground is open early May to late October. Full service is available from Memorial Day week to mid-September'; 'Seasons of Use May to October') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232339/rates (2026 First-come, First-served Seasons 05-08 to 05-21 and 09-07 to 10-17), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reserve at least four days ahead (877-444-6777 or recreation.gov); reservations recommended Memorial Day - Labor Day. 25 of the 63 catalogued sites are first-come all season, and the shoulder weeks are first-come only; first-come sites must be occupied the same night, self-service fee tube. Two nights on weekends, three on holiday weekends. 14 nights in a rolling 60 days. Check in with the host.

booking.source: FS page ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance'; 'Reservations are recommended between Memorial Day and Labor Day'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night') + rec.gov rules (reservationCutOff 4 'Not Available', minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days') + rates (2026 Peak Season 05-22 to 09-06) + catalog (38 reservable, 25 not), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $28 a site; two vehicles or one RV and tow vehicle included, $11 a night for a third vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232339/rates (2026 Peak and First-come seasons: RV / STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28) + FS page ('$28 fee per site for overnight camping ... $11 fee for a third vehicle'), read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: FS page ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-27
